payload.content: Ops plan (provisioner, phase 1): Inventories checked — GH IV=20 PPE=21, StM IV=20 PPE=21. Both hospitals already at/above safe buffers (IV>=6, PPE>=8), zero active failures, so NO transfers this phase (avoids holding-cost waste). I will monitor for any failure alerts or top-up requests and act immediately next phase if buffers drop. Triage: proceed with your scheduling as planned; flag me on this board if you expect IV/PPE demand to spike.
